C fe007.dirs-meaningful OL FE-007,ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create frontend directories only when they contain meaningful code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-computed EX FE-004 PREFER ;; Use computed for derived state; avoid unnecessary effect() when computed, template binding or event handling is clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Signal API technique not entailed by FE-004.
C fe011.compose-operators OL FE-011,FE-004 DEFAULT ;; Compose RxJS with operators such as switchMap, combineLatest and debounceTime instead of nesting subscriptions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe003.no-raw-http OL FE-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not expose raw HTTP details throughout presentation components. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe001.provider-config OL FE-001 DEFAULT ;; Use provider-based HttpClient configuration when configuration is required. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe008.class-interceptor-reason OL FE-008 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce class-based interceptors without a reason. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.ui-ux-only OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Token attachment, auth state display, hidden actions and route guards are UX; server-side authorization stays authoritative. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe009.one-place OL FE-009 MUST ;; Map ProblemDetails errors in one reusable place (interceptor plus parsing helper) and expose UI-friendly error state. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe003.explicit-mapping OL FE-003,FE-010 MUST ;; Keep transport/request mapping explicit; Reactive Forms for non-trivial forms. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-no-domain-dup EX FE-010 MUST_NOT ;; Do not duplicate complex Domain rules in TypeScript unless the UI genuinely needs an equivalent user-facing rule. ;; = ;; UI needs an equivalent rule. ;; Not stated in FE-010/FE-003.
C fe006.start-simple OL FE-006,DEP-015 DEFAULT ;; Start with component state, Signals, feature service/store and RxJS; a state library only when complexity demonstrates need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-material EX DEP-014 DEFAULT ;; When Angular Material is chosen use it consistently for common primitives; do not add it automatically to projects that have not chosen it; do not wrap every Material component without a concrete reason. ;; = ;; none ;; Material usage conventions beyond DEP-014.
C wf016.generated-clients OL WF-016 DEFAULT ;; Treat adopted OpenAPI-generated client code as generated: keep it separate and regenerate when the contract changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-testing EX TST-003,TST-011 DEFAULT ;; Frontend tests target meaningful component behaviour, validation, data-access mapping, route/auth behaviour and complex state; not framework internals; E2E for a few important workflows unless broader coverage is required; no duplication across levels. ;; = ;; Broader E2E when required. ;; Oracle testing policies are backend-scoped.
C x.ng-performance EX RUN-001,FE-005 DEFAULT ;; Do not prematurely optimize Angular code; lazy loading and sensible rendering/data access first; memoization/virtual scrolling/custom change detection after a real need. ;; = ;; none ;; Frontend optimization discipline beyond backend-scoped RUN policies.
C x.ng-security-review EX WF-020,SEC-003 DEFAULT ;; In security review investigate deliberate sanitizer bypasses (bypassSecurityTrustHtml/Script/ResourceUrl) and direct DOM manipulation with untrusted content; ordinary Angular binding is sanitized. ;; = ;; none ;; Framework-specific review guidance not in the oracle.
C dep024.ng-scaffold OL DEP-024,DEP-014 MUST ;; Create the workspace under frontend/<Name>.Web/ with the current Angular CLI using the baseline (standalone, strict, routing, SCSS, zoneless when supported, CLI Vitest setup). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep014.cli-versions OL DEP-014 MUST ;; Let the CLI select mutually compatible Angular, TypeScript and RxJS versions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep.material-via-add-dependency OL DEP-003,DEP-014 MUST ;; Add Angular Material/CDK with ng add through add-dependency. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-test-placement EX DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Unit/component tests are colocated in the workspace; Playwright E2E tests, when required, live under frontend/<Name>.Web/e2e/. ;; = ;; none ;; Frontend test placement convention not in the oracle.
C wf018.workspace-scripts OL WF-018,WF-005 MUST ;; Build and test through the scripts the workspace defines (e.g. npm run build, npm test). ;; = ;; none ;;

134-139 DU ;; Check-by-reference list against api.md § API Versioning (and related owners: ARC-026 per-version models, API-022 silent removal, ARC-010 Minimal API groups, API-015 mixed strategies); owner constraints captured there.

C arc026.versioning-at-contract OL ARC-026 MUST ;; Versioning belongs to the API contract, not Domain or Application. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api013.compatible-in-current OL API-013,API-014 DEFAULT ;; Compatible additions stay in the current version. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api013.when-useful OL API-013 MUST_NOT ;; Explicit versioning is for non-atomic client upgrades, coexisting generations, public/independent consumers, expected breaking changes or migration windows; do not add v1 automatically. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api015.alternatives-justified OL API-015 DEFAULT ;; Header and query-string versioning are alternatives only when project requirements justify them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.not-only-compiles OL API-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not judge compatibility only by whether the code compiles. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.versioned-docs OL API-016 MUST ;; Generate separate/grouped documents per supported version when clients need them; documented versions match runtime routing and controller metadata. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.versions-keep-http OL API-003 MUST ;; Version changes do not override normal HTTP semantics. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.av-testing EX TST-002,API-022 DEFAULT ;; When versions coexist test routing, version-specific shapes, deprecated versions operational during support, unsupported-version behaviour and shared behaviour consistency; no duplicated identical tests. ;; = ;; Coexisting versions. ;; Version-specific test obligations not in the oracle.
